Two Killed in Separate Incidents After Cars Hit Scooters

Two separate incidents involving cars hitting scooters have resulted in fatalities. In Gurugram, a Mercedes car collided with a scooter, leading to one death. In Muzaffarpur, a luxury car hit a scooter, killing two women. Investigations are underway for the Muzaffarpur incident.
